Chapter 6629: Still No Chance

Chapter 6629: Still No Chance

“Bam!” Staff Ancestor unleashed a strike, scaring the soul out of the body. Emperors and desolate gods, if targeted, would be reduced to blood instantly. Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers would be suppressed.

A single thought of her could kill all things at the moment. On the other side, Light God harnessed the infinite power of his immortal weapon.

However, she could penetrate all life force and temporal barriers, crushing his defenses and sending him flying.

He lost his grip on Time Stopper. It grew wings and flew into the maelstrom.

“Now!” Godstallion sped toward it.

“Ugh...” As for Light God, he finally stood up but lost his balance, vomiting a mouthful of blood.

“Impressive.” She nodded approvingly after seeing him get back up again and remarked: “You can inherit their legacy.”

Her voice was sweet enough to melt bones but others were too intimidated to appreciate it. Of course, they remembered to admire Light God’s tenacity as well, surviving a second strike and still standing tall.

How many moves could he last against someone capable of destroying Three Immortals instantly?

Unfortunately for some, it became clear that their lifelong efforts to cultivate were for naught. After all, their fate was subjected to another’s whim.

Meanwhile, Time Stopper plunged into the maelstrom and issued the sounds of gears turning. Initially, Li Qiye’s touch caused the precise pieces to rotate, condensing the flow of time within.

Now, the rotations reversed abruptly and time flowed outward, negating the spinning maelstrom.

“Boom!” The counter-current caused both entities to slow down. The strings of time from Time Stopper began surging back into every corner of the maelstrom like intricate cogs jamming into rapidly rotating gears.

Eventually, it jammed the maelstrom, stopping the rotation entirely without destroying it.

This caused an immense shock throughout the entire world. Both space and Heaven World felt as if the fabric of space-time had been forcefully flung outward by a compelling inertial force. The whole world seemed to spin away like a frisbee. Fortunately, the fabrics and laws of reality held it firmly.

If the halting process had lacked precision, the resulting explosion from stopping the maelstrom would have destroyed all of Three Immortals.

Chaotic time waves would have reduced inhabitants to dust. Only those with the perfect hiding spot would have survived.

Now, the spring of fortune became exposed before everyone. The mist permeated, causing those nearby to feel rejuvenated both physically and mentally.

The closest primal ancestors approached the spring. After buzzing noises, visual phenomena appeared around them.

Grand Preceptor had an archaic radiance erupting behind him. Two majestic wings appeared behind Godstallion with a holy power. A dao with nine parts appeared behind Jiu Ning, opening a new domain of swords...

“How miraculous.” They became emotional.

“This is a supreme fortune.” Weaker cultivators arrived and wanted a piece of the pie.

“Created from a supreme overlord’s metamorphosis.” A primal ancestor said.

Li Xingchen had a wonderful source. Now, he wanted to evolve into the Lord of All Things. The spring was a byproduct of the process. His essence and true blood turned into this spring; its water was far more valuable than any alchemy material.

It was the purest form of fortune and life. It had numerous uses and no side effects.
